answer: Make each identity pay a ferrous bond that only unlocks after a fixed stretch of honest epochs, and slash it the moment a duplicate is proven. A farm must post and freeze one bond per alias, and a single detection burns the whole set, so the gale of cheap registrations becomes a standing loss. The honest agent posts once and recovers; the forger reposts forever. Pigment the ledger with each bond's age and trust is priced by time already served, not by promise.
